title: LGIM策略师：美元贬值论被夸大，长期侵蚀但波动为主
speaker: Ben Bennett

segments.en: I think the debatement has always been an exaggeration. I think the erosion of the dollar is something that we've seen over the last decade or so. And that's not going to go away.
segments.zh: 我认为贬值论一直是被夸大的。美元的被侵蚀是过去十年左右我们看到的现象，而且不会消失。

segments.en: And that's partly because there are other countries that are coming through. There are strong as the US. And the dollar was so dominant for many, many decades that there's only one way that that goes, some sort of erosion.
segments.zh: 部分原因是其他国家正在崛起，它们和美国一样强大。而美元主导了这么多年，所以只能有一种趋势，就是某种程度的侵蚀。

segments.en: So debatement, I've never been a big fan of calling it debatement. I think the dollar will just fluctuate over time. We've been long the dollar at the beginning of this year because the US looks as though it was a stronger economy.
segments.zh: 所以贬值论，我从来不喜欢用这个词。我认为美元会随时间波动。今年年初我们做多美元，因为美国经济看起来更强。

segments.en: It's been weakening just on the back of what's got best. And as said, but it's only been a couple of percent. So I'm not particularly worried. And I'm certainly not shifting all my money into gold or Bitcoin on the back of this. I think it's just fluctuations.
segments.zh: 美元因为某些原因走弱，但只有几个百分点。所以我并不特别担心。我肯定不会因此把资金都转向黄金或比特币。我认为这只是波动。

segments.en: OK, well, is equity still fair to say that's still your main overweight for most investor profiles? That's right. So on the equity side, we still like the earnings.
segments.zh: 好的，那么对于大多数投资者来说，权益类资产是否仍然是你的主要超配？没错。在权益方面，我们仍然看好盈利。
